Reshiram

Dragon Fire

Unova · Generation 5 · Legendary Pokémon

Reshiram is a Dragon/Fire-type Vast White Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 3.2 m tall and weighs 330 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (150), with a base stat total of 680.
